response item: new instance of an admitted form at a demanded endpoint

relations.statement: No response of at most one item separates <a> and <ab> from the form-less, instance-less regime.
relations.hypotheses: Sealed Genesis response grammar NewDatum, NewForm, NewInst, NewRuleAll; item count mu1; each admitted item counted once.

relations.statement: One new unary form with one instance at a demanded endpoint separates <a> and <ab>, so min mu1 = 2.
relations.hypotheses: Same grammar; reading L and reading F.

lemmas.statement: The minimum item count to separate <a> and <ab> is 2 in both readings L and F.
Under mu2 = (items, new-form arity sum) the unique minimum up to source isomorphism is the unary mark with cost (2,1), in reading L and reading F.

near_misses.claim: The minimizer under mu2 is a binary edge or link.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A binary link has mu2 = (2,2), which is strictly greater than the unary mark at (2,1). The two tie only under mu1.
cost_floor is a fixture parameter, so checking its value does not reprove minimality. Minimality needs cost1_insufficient_general together with an explicit separating response.

open_obligations: No existing declaration is grounded, since @SRC is empty. Names such as cost1_insufficient_general, mu2_unique and mu2_unique_F are not cited as existing.
